result.rationale: Diff shows `totalPages` as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` (admin-group.js.es6) and `next` clamping offset via `Math.min(group.get("offset") + group.get("limit"), group.get("user_count"))`, and findMembers clamps `offset = Math.min(this.get("user_count"), ...)`. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 50/50), totalPages = 2 though only 1 page exists, and next sets offset = user_count (50), producing an empty phantom page instead of max valid offset (limit-1 pages). The mechanism is fully verifiable in the diff.

judged_text: Pagination math is off-by-one, producing a blank phantom page when user_count is an exact multiple of limit: totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 instead of Math.ceil(user_count / limit), and both the next action and findMembers clamp offset to Math.min(offset + limit, user_count), permitting the invalid state offset == user_count; the correct max offset is (totalPages - 1) * limit (admin-group.js.es6:13, :33, group.js:21)
